cards.title: Starting point (adopt, adapt, or create)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) For small teams (1-5 people, which is 61% of teams [S-L11-030]), adapt an accessible headless or themeable base and put your effort into tokens and docs. Create from scratch only if you have a dedicated team and a strong brand differentiation need [inferred from S-L11-006, S-L11-030].

cards.title: Scope: products, platforms, stack, audience
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Scope version 1 to the products the pilot touches, and list the products you will not serve [S-L11-083]. Add platforms only when a real product needs them.

cards.title: System posture (Kholmatova's parameters)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Strict core (tokens, primitives, accessibility behavior), loose edges (patterns, marketing) [inferred]. Kholmatova's point, as summarized by practitioners, is to pick deliberately and manage the downsides [S-L11-019].

cards.title: Audit method (interface inventory)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Do the manual inventory even when automated data exists. Its main value is shared vocabulary and buy-in, not the count [S-L11-001].

cards.title: Design principles
cards.default: (default + heuristic) 3-5 principles, each testable by a "would this screen pass?" question. Avoid generic words that every product could claim ("simple", "beautiful") [inferred].

cards.title: Build order (foundations first vs components first vs pilot-driven)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Minimal foundations first (color roles, type scale, spacing scale, radius), then pilot-driven components, then back-fill foundations as components expose gaps [inferred synthesis of S-L11-009, S-L11-014, S-L11-107].

cards.title: Pilot selection
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Score 2-3 candidates on the 8 criteria. Pick the one with a champion and common components, then plan a second pilot from a different product family to reduce bias [S-L11-105].

cards.title: Rollout strategy
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Incremental, led by pain points, unless a rebrand gives you a natural big-bang moment [S-L11-105].

cards.title: Team model
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Start centralized (even with 1-2 people) with a named owner. Add federated contributors once there is a contribution process. Survey data shows federated teams are the most under-resourced [S-L11-030].

cards.title: Roles and staffing
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Role skills summary (see the table in Part F): the DS designer needs systems thinking plus Figma variables and components; the DS engineer needs component APIs, tokens pipeline and testing; the PM needs roadmap, adoption and value storytelling; the content designer needs voice and microcopy guidelines; the accessibility specialist needs WCAG plus assistive-technology testing [inferred synthesis of S-L11-006, S-L11-098, S-L11-105].

cards.title: Contribution model
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Two lanes: a fast lane for fixes, icons and docs; a proposal lane (RFC) for new components, gated by "useful + unique" before any build work [S-L11-021, S-L11-020].

cards.title: Governance flow and decision records
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Adopt the 10-step flow. Log every foundation decision as an ADR from day one; the builder's Decision Cards map naturally to ADRs [inferred].

cards.title: Component lifecycle / status labels
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Three states (experimental, ready, deprecated) are enough for most teams. Primer itself simplified from five to three [S-L11-025, S-L11-026].

cards.title: Versioning strategy
cards.default: (default + heuristic) One semver for the whole library while small. Move to per-package versions once you have more than one platform. Release on a predictable cadence and write release notes every time; release notes are the most common governance ritual, at 56% [S-L11-030].

cards.title: Deprecation and migration policy
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Deprecate in a minor, remove in the next major, give at least one release cycle of notice, and pair every removal with a codemod or migration guide [S-L11-100, S-L11-106].

cards.title: Source of truth and design-code sync
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Make the builder's own token file the source of truth. Export to Figma variables and to code in one step, which closes the gap that 60% of teams have [S-L11-030; inferred].

cards.title: Documentation platform
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Small teams: document in Figma plus Storybook. Add a docs platform when non-engineers need to author. Whatever the tool, also publish a machine-readable export (llms.txt or MCP) [S-L11-048, S-L11-108].

cards.title: Component documentation page template
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Use the template above. Make "docs complete" part of the definition of done, since Figma calls docs updates "a required step" [S-L11-088].

cards.title: Accessibility program
cards.default: (default + heuristic) WCAG 2.2 AA. The system guarantees component-level behavior and contrast-safe token pairs. Product teams own page-level criteria, content, and composition testing. Publish that split explicitly [S-L11-092, S-L11-093, S-L11-094]. Signal: in the zeroheight 2026 report only 59% of systems include accessibility guidelines, and accessibility satisfaction is 44% [S-L11-030].

cards.title: Success metrics and instrumentation
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Start with three measures: design adoption (Figma analytics), code adoption (a scanner), and a quarterly satisfaction survey. Add speed or ROI studies only when leadership asks [inferred from S-L11-030 frequencies].

cards.title: Maturity stage targeting
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Most builder users will be at stage 1. Design the onboarding for stage 1 and grow features toward stage 2-4 [inferred].

cards.title: Communication and community rituals
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Minimum viable set: release notes every release, a public roadmap, and a support channel [S-L11-030, S-L11-002].

cards.title: Agent-readable distribution (how AI tools consume the system)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Ship at least one live channel (MCP) and one file channel (DESIGN.md + DTCG). Keep guidelines as many short, structured files. Test with evals rather than hoping docs changes work [S-L11-108, S-L11-051].

cards.title: AI guardrails (enforcement, linting, evals)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) The builder should export lint rules alongside tokens, so every generated system arrives with its own guardrails [inferred].

cards.title: Theming dimensions (modes, brands, density, platforms)
cards.default: (default + heuristic) Light plus dark from day one, since 76% of systems do it. Add brand and density dimensions only when a real product needs them [S-L11-030].
